reconstructed_captions.16: The man fits the stone axe head into a notch on a wooden handle.
reconstructed_captions.17: He applies a dark, sticky resin to secure the axe head to the handle.
reconstructed_captions.18: He begins to wrap a natural fiber cord around the axe head and handle.
reconstructed_captions.19: A close-up shows his hands tightly lashing the axe head to the wooden handle.
reconstructed_captions.20: He continues to wrap the cordage, creating a strong and secure bond.
reconstructed_captions.21: He pulls the cordage tight, finishing the lashing around the axe head.
reconstructed_captions.22: The man holds up the completed stone axe, inspecting its sturdy construction.
reconstructed_captions.23: He picks up a thick piece of wood to use as a mallet.
reconstructed_captions.24: The man approaches a tree, holding the stone axe and a wooden mallet.
